Reasoning: According to the specified method, label the regular octagon clockwise as A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, where A is the left end of the upper side, B is the right end of the upper side, C is the vertex of the upper-right vertical side, D is the vertex of the lower-right vertical side, E is the right end of the lower side, F is the left end of the lower side, G is the vertex of the lower-left vertical side, and H is the vertex of the upper-left vertical side. In the figure, the upper side of the shaded parallelogram is on HC, the lower side is on GD, the right side is on AD, and the left side is on HE. The side length of the regular octagon is 2, and the oblique sides make 45° with the horizontal and vertical directions, so the horizontal and vertical projections of each oblique side are both 2/√2 = √2. Take coordinates: H = (-√2, 2), C = (2 + √2, 2), G = (-√2, 0), D = (2 + √2, 0), A = (0, 2 + √2), E = (2, -√2). The line AD passes through A(0, 2 + √2) and D(2 + √2, 0), and its slope is -1, so its equation is y = -x + 2 + √2. When it intersects HC, namely y = 2, 2 = -x + 2 + √2, giving x = √2, so the intersection point P = (√2, 2). The line HE passes through H(-√2, 2) and E(2, -√2), and its slope is also -1, so its equation is y = -x + 2 - √2. When it intersects GD, namely y = 0, 0 = -x + 2 - √2, giving x = 2 - √2, so the intersection point Q = (2 - √2, 0). The length of the upper base HP of the shaded parallelogram is √2 - (-√2) = 2√2, and the height is the distance between the two horizontal lines y = 2 and y = 0, namely 2. Therefore the area is (2√2)(2) = 4√2.

method.method_draft: Coordinate-intersection route. First describe the diagram by labeling the regular octagon clockwise as A = upper-left end of the top side, B = upper-right end of the top side, C = upper-right vertical-side vertex, D = lower-right vertical-side vertex, E = lower-right end of the bottom side, F = lower-left end of the bottom side, G = lower-left vertical-side vertex, and H = upper-left vertical-side vertex. From the image, the shaded region is the parallelogram bounded above by the horizontal diagonal HC, below by the horizontal diagonal GD, on the right by diagonal AD, and on the left by diagonal HE. From the text, each octagon side has length 2. Place coordinates using the fact that the slanted sides of this regular octagon make 45-degree angles, so their horizontal and vertical projections are sqrt(2): take H = (-sqrt(2), 2), C = (2 + sqrt(2), 2), G = (-sqrt(2), 0), D = (2 + sqrt(2), 0), A = (0, 2 + sqrt(2)), and E = (2, -sqrt(2)). Compute where AD meets HC and where HE meets GD. These are P = (sqrt(2), 2) and Q = (2 - sqrt(2), 0). Thus the shaded parallelogram has horizontal base HP = 2sqrt(2) and vertical height 2, giving area 4sqrt(2).

method.method_draft: Area-subtraction route. From the image, view the middle band between the two horizontal diagonals as a rectangle whose left and right sides are the vertical sides of the octagon. The shaded region is this rectangle minus two unshaded right triangles: one at the lower-left corner of the band and one at the upper-right corner of the band. From the text, the octagon side length is 2, so the rectangle height is 2. Its width is the top side length 2 plus the horizontal projections of the two adjacent slanted octagon sides; each projection is sqrt(2), so the rectangle width is 2 + 2sqrt(2). Therefore the middle rectangle has area 2(2 + 2sqrt(2)). The two missing corner triangles each have one vertical leg equal to 2 and, because the bounding diagonals are at 45 degrees, one horizontal leg also equal to 2, so each triangle has area 2. Subtracting both triangles gives 2(2 + 2sqrt(2)) - 4 = 4sqrt(2).
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个正八边形，内部画出了四条对角线。中间有一条由两条水平对角线夹成的水平带状区域，这个带状区域的左右边界正好是八边形的两条竖直边。青色阴影区域位于这个中间水平带内，形状可看作整个中间矩形去掉左下角和右上角两个未涂色的直角三角形。推理：正八边形边长为 2，所以中间矩形的高度等于竖直边长，即 2。矩形宽度等于上边水平边长 2 加上左右相邻两条 45° 斜边的水平投影。每条斜边长为 2，水平投影为 2/√2=√2，因此矩形宽度为 2+2√2。中间矩形面积为 2(2+2√2)=4+4√2。图中被减去的两个角上的直角三角形分别由 45° 对角线切出，每个三角形的竖直腿为 2，水平腿也为 2，所以每个面积为 (1/2)·2·2=2，两个共 4。因此阴影面积为 (4+4√2)-4=4√2。

The length of the upper base HP of the shaded parallelogram is √2 - (-√2) = 2√2, and the height is the distance between the two horizontal lines y = 2 and y = 0, namely 2. Therefore the area is (2√2)(2) = 4√2.
